lines.text: Copy a triangle, and slide the copy to the right.
lines.caption: Copy a triangle, and slide the copy to the right.

lines.text: How much of the copy sticks out? Lots of kids say twenty-four. That's wrong!
lines.caption: How much of the copy sticks out? Lots of kids say twenty-four. That's wrong!

lines.text: The legs are twelve and nine, and the copy slides four to the right.
lines.caption: The legs are twelve and nine, and the copy slides four to the right.

lines.text: What is the area of the shaded part of the copy?
lines.caption: What is the area of the shaded part of the copy?

lines.text: Here's the trick. The whole copy has area fifty-four.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. The whole copy has area fifty-four.

lines.text: The overlap is a smaller copy of the same shape.
lines.caption: The overlap is a smaller copy of the same shape.

lines.text: Its bottom is eight out of twelve, so its height is six. Its area is twenty-four.
lines.caption: Its bottom is eight out of twelve, so its height is six. Its area is twenty-four.

lines.text: Why is it a smaller copy? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
